charts.title: Size of the worldwide market for dietary supplements from 2018 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Size of the worldwide market for dietary supplements 2018-2028
charts.description: The global dietary supplement market is forecast to reach a market value of 185.1 billion U.S. dollars in 2025. In 2021, it was estimated to be worth around 137 billion U.S. dollars. The market has been growing since 2018 and is expected to continue to grow till 2028.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2018 to 2028; *Year of data release Read more

charts.title: Value of the dietary supplements market worldwide in 2018 and 2020 with a forecast to 2026, by region (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Regional breakdown of the size of the global dietary supplements market 2018-2026
charts.description: Between 2018 and 2020, the North American dietary supplements market grew from 42.6 to 50.7 billion U.S. dollars. The market is projected to grow further and reach about 72 billion U.S. dollars by 2026. The Asia-Pacific market in 2026 is forecast to be about 20 billion U.S. dollars smaller than its NA counterpart. Europe has the smallest market of the regions depicted here and it is expected to stay that way.

charts.title: Size of the worldwide functional food and beverage market from 2020 to 2021 with a forecast to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Size of the worldwide functional food and beverage market 2020-2028
charts.description: In 2021, the global functional foods and beverage market was worth 281.14 billion U.S. dollars. The market is predicted to grow at a compound annual growth rate of about 9.5 percent between 2021 and 2028. For 2028, the market is forecast to be worth over half a trillion U.S. dollars.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2020 to 2021; * Forecasts. Data for years 2022 to 2027 has been calculated by Statista using a CAGR with starting and end points provided by the source. Read more

charts.title: Revenue of the vitamins & minerals market worldwide from 2020 to 2029 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the vitamins & minerals industry worldwide 2020-2029
charts.description: The global revenue in the 'Vitamins & Minerals' segment of the otc pharmaceuticals market was forecast to continuously increase between 2024 and 2029 by in total 12.3 billion U.S. dollars (+38.52 percent). After the ninth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 44.18 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2029. Notably, the revenue of the 'Vitamins & Minerals' segment of the otc pharmaceuticals market was continuously increasing over the past years.

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Forecast of the global probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027
charts.description: The global market for probiotic supplements is forecast to increase from 1.5 billion U.S. dollars in 2019 to 3.3 billion in 2027. This would constitute more than a doubling of market values in that time frame. Between 2017 and 2020, market values grew by almost 600 million U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Import value of vitamins worldwide in 2022, by country (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Import value of vitamins worldwide in 2022, by country
charts.description: In 2022, the United States was the leading worldwide importer of vitamin products in the world. The country imported vitamins worth 1.6 billion U.S. dollars. Three European countries followed the U.S. in import values of vitamins. Germany, the Netherlands, and France had a combined import value of slightly more than the U.S. imports.

charts.title: Export value of vitamins worldwide in 2021, by country (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Export value of vitamins worldwide in 2021, by country
charts.description: The leading global exporter of vitamins in 2021 was China. The country exported approximately 3.7 billion U.S. dollars worth of vitamins and vitamin preparations across the globe. U.S. exports had a value of less than a third of Chinese exports and came to about one billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Import quantities of vitamins worldwide in 2021, by country (in kilograms)
charts.short: Import volume of vitamins worldwide in 2021, by country
charts.description: In 2021, seven of the leading ten importers of vitamins were European Countries. However, at 120,079 kilograms, imports to the United States were the highest volume of any country on the globe. The Netherlands was the leading European importer measured by volume with total imports amounting to 38,352 kilograms of vitamins.
charts.source: UN Comtrade Import volume in metric tons

charts.title: Export quantities of vitamins worldwide in 2022, by country (in million kilograms)
charts.short: Export volume of vitamins worldwide in 2022, by country
charts.description: The leading global exporter of vitamins in 2022 was the China. The country exported almost 342 million kilograms of vitamins and vitamin preparations across the globe. The next biggest exporter of vitamins was the Netherlands, with nearly 70 million kilograms.
charts.source: UN Comtrade Export volume in million kilograms

charts.short: Revenue of the vitamins & minerals market worldwide by country 2023

charts.title: Revenue growth of the vitamins & minerals market worldwide from 2020 to 2029
charts.short: Revenue growth of vitamins & minerals worldwide 2020-2029
charts.description: The global revenue change in the 'Vitamins & Minerals' segment of the otc pharmaceuticals market was forecast to continuously decrease between 2024 and 2029 by in total 1.5 percentage points. According to this forecast in 2029, the indicator will have decreased for the sixth consecutive year to 5.98 percent.

charts.title: Leading supplements and vitamins used by supplement consumers in the U.S., the UK, and China in 2019
charts.short: Leading supplements & vitamins consumed in the U.S., the UK, and China in 2019
charts.description: Vitamin C was the leading supplement consumed by survey respondents in China, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The representative survey found that 46 percent of all those respondents who had consumed any supplement in the past 30 days had consumed Vitamin C in 2019. Vitamin D and Calcium ranked second and third among respondents with 41 and 34 percent of respondents stating they consumed these supplements, respectively.
charts.note: China, United Kingdom, United States; May 2019; 2257*; 18-70 years; Consumers who have used a dietary supplement in the last thirty days.; * (U.S. = 753, UK = 750, China = 756). The survey is representative. Read more

charts.title: Leading reasons to consume supplements and vitamins among supplement consumers in the U.S., the UK, and China in 2019
charts.short: Leading reasons to consume supplements & vitamins in the U.S., the UK & China in 2019
charts.description: General Health concerns were the leading reason to take vitamins and other supplements among survey respondents in China, the United Kingdom, and the United States in 2019. Viewed individually heart health trumped this concern slightly among Chinese respondents, while general health outpaced other concerns in the U.S. and in the UK. Overall 43 percent of respondents named general health as a reason to take nutritional supplements. Respondents were representative of the larger [...]

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars), by region
charts.short: Forecast of the global probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027, by region
charts.description: The markets for probiotic supplements in different regions across the world are forecast to grow at somewhat similar rates. North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific are forecast to remain the three largest regions for probiotic supplements, with a significant gap in market share in comparison to Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Europe is forecast to grow its estimated market value of 365 million U.S. dollars in 2017 to approximately 920.6 million in 2027.

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value in online stores from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Forecast of the online global probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027
charts.description: The global market for probiotic supplements in online stores is forecast to increase from 363.4 million U.S. dollars in 2019 to 955 million in 2027. This would constitute more than a doubling of market values in that time frame. Between 2017 and 2020, market values grew by around 180 million U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide dry probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars), by type
charts.short: Forecast of the global dry probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027, by type
charts.description: The various types of dry probiotic supplements on the global market are forecast to have similar compound annual growth rates, between 9.13 percent for tablets and 10.76 percent for chewable supplements. In 2017, capsules were estimated to have more than double the sales than any other type of probiotic supplement. The market value of capsules in 2027 is forecast to be 1.47 billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars), by application
charts.short: Forecast of the global probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027, by application
charts.description: In 2020, the worldwide market for probiotic supplements used for gastrointestinal health was worth 1.1 billion U.S. dollars. It is predicted to grow to 2.1 billion U.S. dollars. The markets for all types of applications are forecast to grow with the smallest growth predicted for the urinary tract health items.
charts.note: Worldwide; 2017 to 2027; ** Forecast released Dec 2020.; * The Source notes that other Applications include Skin health, prostate health, cardiovascular health, stress and mood maintenance, metabolic health, blood sugar level [...] Read more

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars), by form
charts.short: Worldwide probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027, by form
charts.description: The global market value of probiotic supplements in the form of liquids is predicted to increase from approximately 207 million U.S. dollars in 2017 to nearly 648 million in 2027. In comparison, the market share of probiotic supplements in dry form is predicted to grow from approximately one billion in 2017 to nearly 2.6 billion in 2027.

charts.title: Forecast of the worldwide probiotic supplements market value from 2017 to 2027 (in million U.S. dollars), by source
charts.short: Forecast of the global probiotic supplements market value 2017-2027, by source
charts.description: When dividing the forecast of the market for probiotic supplements by their sources, an increase in products that have bacteria as their source is predicted. Such products are forecast to grow from approximately 1.1 billion U.S. dollars in 2017 to nearly 3 billion in 2027. This translates to a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.69 percent. charts.title: Revenue of BASF's Nutrition & Care segment from 2019 to 2023 (in million euros)
charts.short: BASF's Nutrition & Care segment revenue 2019-2023
charts.description: BASF's revenue in the Nutrition & Care segment stood at around 6.86 billion euros in 2023. The Nutrition & Care segment of BASF was newly formed in 2019 and consists of the company's Nutrition & Health and Care Chemicals divisions, which serve various aspects of the fast-moving consumer goods market, including food and animal feed, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, cleaners and detergents.

charts.title: Distribution of Bayer Group's net sales from 2021 to 2023, by segment
charts.short: Distribution of Bayer Group's net sales 2021-2023 by segment
charts.description: This statistic depicts the distribution of Bayer Group's net sales from 2021 to 2023, by segment. Bayer consists of following main segments: Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Health, and Crop Science. Covestro (ex-MaterialScience) and Animal Health were spun-off during 2015 and 2019, respectively. In 2023, Bayer Pharmaceuticals generated 38 percent of Bayer's total net sales.

charts.title: Revenue of Sanofi by segment from 2014 to 2023 (in million euros)
charts.short: Sanofi - revenue by segment 2014-2023
charts.description: In 2023, French pharmaceutical and healthcare company Sanofi generated approximately 38 billion euros through its biopharmaceutical segment. Sanofi’s consumer healthcare segment earned the company about 5.2 billion euros in that year.

charts.title: Revenue of Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) in 2022, by segment (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Archer Daniels Midland's revenue 2022, by segment
charts.description: This statistic shows the revenue of agricultural company Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) in 2022, by segment. The animal nutrition segment generated revenue of about 3.9 billion U.S. dollars in that year. ADM is an U.S.-based global food processing and commodity trading corporation. The company's special focus lays on processing of oilseeds and soybeans. ADM is headquartered in Decatur, Illinois.
charts.note: Worldwide; Fiscal year ended on December 31, 2022

charts.title: Abbott Laboratories' Nutritionals segment revenue from 2019 to 2023, by category (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Abbott's Nutritional segment revenue by category 2019-2023
charts.description: This statistic shows Abbott Laboratories' revenue of the Nutritionals segment from 2019 to 2023, broken down by category. In 2023, the International Pediatric Nutritionals segment generated approximately two billion U.S. dollars.

charts.title: Glanbia's revenue from 2016 to 2021, by segment (in million euros)
charts.short: Revenue of Glanbia by segment 2016-2021
charts.description: This statistic displays the global revenue of Glanbia from 2016 to 2021, by segment. In 2021, Glanbia generated some 1.3 billion euros of revenue through its Global Performance Nutrition segment. Glanbia plc is a manufacturer of sports nutrition, dairy products, vitamins, minerals, and other supplements. The company is headquartered in Kilkenny, Ireland.

charts.title: Perrigo Company's revenue from 2018 to 2023, by segment (in million U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of Perrigo by segment 2018-2023
charts.description: This statistic displays the revenue of the Perrigo Company by segment from 2018 to 2023. In 2023, Perrigo generated a total revenue of roughly 4.7 billion U.S. dollars, of which nearly three billion were generated from the Consumer self-care Americas (CSCA) segment. Perrigo Company plc is a manufacturer of pharmaceutical over-the-counter (OTC) products. The company has one of its headquarters in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

charts.description: This statistic depicts Herbalife's net sales share worldwide in 2022, by product category. In 2022, 56.8 percent of Herbalife's net sales came from the company's weight management category.

charts.short: Otsuka Holdings' revenue share FY 2022, by segment
charts.description: Otsuka Holdings Co., Ltd generated the largest revenue share, around 66 percent, through their pharmaceutical business in the fiscal year 2022. About 25 percent of the revenue was from the nutraceutical business.
